name: The Mask: Animated Series
description: Insecure bank clerk Stanley Ipkiss uses an ancient mask to gain superpowers while taking on the mischievous and cartoonish, but heroic and good-hearted personality of The Mask

videos.title: The Mask is Always Greener on the Other Side (1)
videos.overview: After causing him nothing but trouble, Stanley Ipkiss gets rid of his mask by burying it in quick-drying cement, but must retrieve it to save Peggy and Milo from Pretorius.

videos.title: The Mask is Always Greener on the Other Side (2)
videos.overview: Pretorius tricks Stanley's friend and co-worker, Charlie, into building a "house of tomorrow". The Mask must stop him and save Peggy, Charlie and Milo.

videos.title: Baby's Wild Ride
videos.overview: When Stanley reluctantly agrees to baby-sit for his neighbors, the mask somehow gets on Baby's face...producing Baby Mask!

videos.title: The Terrible Twos
videos.overview: When Lt. Kellaway suspects that Stanley and The Mask are one and the same, he handcuffs himself to Stanley in order to keep an eye on his every move.

videos.title: Sister Mask
videos.overview: Stanley discovers a fabled "sister" mask that, when joined with his mask, allows him to control his wild alter-ego.

videos.title: Shadow of a Skillit
videos.overview: Shadows are being stolen from all over Edge City! And everyone whose shadow is stolen loses his or her youth and starts to age rapidly.

videos.title: Bride of Pretorius
videos.overview: Stanley falls in love with a very shy woman...but her shyness evaporates when she accidentally dons the mask.

videos.title: Double Reverse
videos.overview: Stanley tries to add some excitement to his life by using "reverse psychology" to let the Mask's personality come out of himself.

videos.title: Shrink Rap
videos.overview: Stanley's psychologist, Dr. Neumann, won't believe that Stanley is The Mask. Out of frustration, Stanley shows his therapist the mask, not expecting the doctor to put it on.

videos.title: Mayor Mask
videos.overview: Stanley is so upset with Edge City's government that his alter ego, The Mask, campaigns for mayor!

videos.title: Martian Mask
videos.overview: When a top-secret government agency believes The Mask to be an alien, Stanley must not only contend with his nemesis, Lt. Kellaway, who believes The Mask is a criminal, but also Agent X.

videos.title: How Much Is That Dog in the Tin Can?
videos.overview: Milo dons the mask to go after an evil dogcatcher who turns out to be a wanted felon.

videos.title: All Hallow's Eve
videos.overview: Skillit returns on Halloween! He's back to claim the mask and pay Stanley back for being put in a school for delinquents.

videos.title: Santa Mask
videos.overview: Kablamus, Walter, and the Terrible Twos are all disguised as Santa Claus to commit crimes. It's up to the Mask to clear Santa's name.

videos.title: Split Personality
videos.overview: The Mask breaks in half during Walter's attempt to retrieve it. Now both Stanley and the Mask are existing at the same time. Chet Bozzack, an old high school bully of Stanley, gets and puts on the other half of the mask.

videos.title: A Comedy of Eras
videos.overview: A mad scientist sends the Mask on a journey through time. He visits the future and goes back to the Salem Witch Trials.

videos.title: Goin' for the Green
videos.overview: The mayor of Edge City recruits a businessman to help distract attention from the Mask. However, the businessman uses the opportunity to store nuclear waste in the city.

videos.title: Flight as a Feather
videos.overview: The Mask loses his lucky fedora feather before a karaoke contest, sending him on a wild hunt through the city.

videos.title: The Good, the Bad and the Fish Guy
videos.overview: When the villainous Fish Guy returns and steals the mask, Stanley has to team up with another villain.

videos.title: Malled
videos.overview: Robbers trap Stanley at the mega-mall. His dog Milo must bring him the mask to save the day.

videos.title: Channel Surfin'
videos.overview: A villain traps the Mask inside a television, sending him on an adventure across the channels.

videos.title: Mask au Gratin
videos.overview: While giving a girl a tour of the city, she transforms into a monster that turns everything into cheese.

videos.title: Jurassic Mask
videos.overview: A machine at the museum brings dinosaurs to life. They escape and wreak havoc on the city.

videos.title: You Oughta Be in Pictures
videos.overview: An action star comes to town to shoot a movie, challenging the Mask and threatening the city with a nuclear bomb.

videos.title: For All Mask-Kind
videos.overview: Stanley is sent into space but the Mask also comes along for the ride.

videos.title: Up the Creek
videos.overview: Stanley and a friend go on a river-rafting trip and wind up almost marrying two hillbilly girls.

videos.title: Boogie with the Man
videos.overview: Envious of the mask's luck, Stanley makes a deal with the devil.

videos.title: What Goes Around Comes Around
videos.overview: A villain traps Stanley in a time loop and he is doomed to relive the same half hour over and over again.

videos.title: All Hail the Mask
videos.overview: When the Mask takes a trip to a Pacific island, the natives worship him as a god. They then decide to sacrifice him.

videos.title: Power of Suggestion
videos.overview: A magician hypnotizes Stanley for entertainment. When a villain interrupts the show, he takes advantage and uses Stanley as his personal slave.

videos.title: Mr. Mask Goes to Washington
videos.overview: The Mask saves the President of the United States from getting crushed, landing him a job as presidential bodyguard.

videos.title: Rain of Terror
videos.overview: A disgraced weatherman turns into a supervillain known as the Tempest.

videos.title: The Mother of All Hoods
videos.overview: After the Mask humiliates Lt. Kellaway, he tries to prove his worth as a policeman by saving the mayor from an evil plot.

videos.title: To Bee or Not to Bee
videos.overview: When a beekeeper is transformed into a bee-human hybrid, he uses powers of hypnosis to make the town work in his beehive.

videos.title: Love Potion Number 8 1/2
videos.overview: A spilled love potion causes Stanley to fall in love with his grumpy landlady.

videos.title: Cool Hand Mask
videos.overview: The Mask is framed for stealing from a children's baseball team. With the Mask in prison, his nemesis Pretorius can finally take over the city.

videos.title: Broadway Malady
videos.overview: A Broadway musical director turns Stanley's favorite action series into a musical. The Mask attempts to ruin the production, sending the director on a mad rampage.

videos.title: Enquiring Masks Want to Know
videos.overview: A villain unleashes a swarm of mythical creatures. Peggy uses the chaos as an opportunity to further her writing career.

videos.title: Future Mask
videos.overview: The Mask travels to the future and is caught in a war between an evil mayor and a rebel army.

videos.title: Sealed Fate
videos.overview: When the Mask racks up a massive credit card bill, Stanley is forced to work as a salesman for the company. However, the company has evil plans.

videos.title: (The Angels Wanna Wear My) Green Mask
videos.overview: The Mask and Lieutenant Kellaway are killed in an explosion and sent to a council of angels.

videos.title: Mutiny of the Bounty Hunters
videos.overview: Dr. Pretorius hires two bounty hunters to capture the Mask, but Stanley is busy babysitting for his neighbor.

videos.title: Convention of Evil
videos.overview: Villains from previous episodes participate in a group therapy session, voicing their troubles with the Mask in this clip show.

videos.title: The Green Marine
videos.overview: When the Mask engages in his usual antics while enlisted in the marines, he is put on trial in a military court.

videos.title: Counterfeit Mask
videos.overview: When Stanley accidentally switches suitcases with another traveler at the airport, Peggy is forced to don the mask.

videos.title: Magic
videos.overview: Stanley reunites with his high school dream girl. She turns out to be a magician and a criminal.

videos.title: Little Big Mask
videos.overview: The Mask creates an anti-aging cream that works a little too well.

videos.title: Fantashtick Voyage
videos.overview: Stanley blames the Mask when his dog Milo is infected with a computer virus.

videos.title: They Came from Within
videos.overview: The Mask and Lieutenant Kellaway get trapped inside a comic book world where characters think the officer is their arch-enemy.

videos.title: To Have and Have Snot
videos.overview: When Dr. Pretorius creates a giant monster out of mucus, Stanley discovers the deadly consequences of having a cold while wearing the mask.

videos.title: Mystery Cruise
videos.overview: Stanley celebrates his birthday by bringing his friends on a cruise, but Dr. Pretorius threatens them with a tidal wave machine.

videos.title: The Goofalotatots
videos.overview: Stanley's favorite cartoon characters come to visit him in real life, stirring up trouble.

videos.title: When Pigs Ruled the Earth
videos.overview: The Mask and Peggy travel through time and visit a futuristic society where pigs keep humans as slaves.

videos.title: The Aceman Cometh
videos.overview: In a special cartoon crossover, Stanley gets some help from Ace Ventura, Pet Detective to recover his kidnapped dog.

country: United States, South Korea, Canada, Philippines, Taiwan
